name: @sos-2/deployment-providers
description: SOS 2.0 Real Deployment Providers (Work Order P17-A, persistence/deployment lane): the real Vercel deployment provider surface wired through the existing deployment contracts (the frozen @sos-2/deployment surface). RealVercelDeploymentProvider performs REAL Vercel API operations (team discovery, project discovery/creation with the git repository link and the apps/web rootDirectory per the P3 vercel contract, deployments from an EXACT git ref) through ONE injectable FetchPort seam (zero ambient network in package src). Every deployment mints a DeploymentRecord through the frozen createDeployment (artifact_revision = ExactRevision kind git-sha bound to the EXACT source_revision_sha of the deployed head), registers a DeploymentRevisionRecord through the P3 registrar contract shape (rollback pointers) and records truthful DeploymentOutcome records (the frozen 6 truth states; READY -> SUCCESS, ERROR -> FAILURE — never fabricated). Honest provider states (CONNECTED/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED) come from REAL probes only; credentials are env-only (VERCEL_TOKEN per the P3 registry name), injected at the composition boundary, never echoed — transcripts are redacted (Authorization -> env-name reference). Deterministic reference-mode: the provider logic runs offline against a scripted FetchPort (injected clocks); network happens only in the env-gated integration suite (RUN_REAL=1, tests/real-persistence). ZERO external dependencies.
